issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings as a private attribute (visibility '-' on the UML), but the solution implementation declares numberOfLoopings as protected. This deviates from the UML visibility and may confuse students about the intended attribute visibility and encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings attribute private in the solution (and template guidance) to match the UML (use 'private int numberOfLoopings;') and keep the public getter. Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to explicitly show protected visibility if subclass direct access is intended.
